notes: Deep ensembles (Lakshminarayanan et al., 2017): members differ only in their random seed (head initialization, data order, augmentation draws), all trained with the base recipe; uniform average of probabilities. The base recipe is shared by every baseline (copied into each config): Adam, ClaugE's pool settings per benchmark, light augmentation (rotation 0/90/270 and horizontal flip), plateau schedule and early stopping on source validation. Paths are relative to the repository root.
